The '''Smartmed 2000 Integrated Med-systems''' was an [[armor accessory]] produced by [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It could keep alive the user until proper treatment.<ref name="DC" />
